description: DDL, input, canonical output, casts, typmods, and catalog OIDs for character, binary, bit, UUID, and JSON types
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_character_binary (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fixed CHARACTER(4), varying CHARACTER VARYING(12), named NAME, internal_char "char", bytes BYTEA, fixed_bits BIT(4), varying_bits VARBIT(8), identifier UUID, document JSON, binary_document JSONB);

INSERT INTO type_matrix_character_binary (id, fixed, varying, named, internal_char, bytes, fixed_bits, varying_bits, identifier, document, binary_document) VALUES ('c1', 'ab', 'hello', 'catalog_name', 'Z', '\x00ff'::bytea, B'1010', B'001101', '018f22e2-7b2a-7cc2-98c4-df37b628f801', '{"b":2,"a":1}', '{"b":2,"a":1}');
SELECT fixed, varying, named, internal_char, bytes, fixed_bits, varying_bits, identifier, document, binary_document FROM type_matrix_character_binary WHERE id = 'c1';

SELECT 'xy'::character(4) AS fixed, 'hello'::varchar(12) AS varying, 'catalog_name'::name AS named, 'Z'::"char" AS internal_char, '\xdeadbeef'::bytea AS bytes, B'1010'::bit(4) AS fixed_bits, B'001101'::varbit(8) AS varying_bits, '018f22e2-7b2a-7cc2-98c4-df37b628f801'::uuid AS identifier, '{"a":1}'::json AS document, '{"a":1}'::jsonb AS binary_document;

SELECT a.attname, a.atttypid, a.atttypmod, pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS formatted_type FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_character_binary' AND a.attnum > 0 ORDER BY a.attnum;
